about: Readings for connection at the coin table in the nook and the hollow (Six-faces-council pass bar-intake-2, his note on bi-table-look-1: advice on how to connect with self or someone in a Between). One per hexagram, keyed by n to hexagrams.json. `reading` is about coming closer; `self` is the move when you toss for yourself, `them` when you toss for someone you share a Between with ({name} is theirs); `lane` is where a move for them goes (partner or between). Written by hand: no AI reads the coins. `drawn` (pass bar-intake-3, brief "Coin table, build 3b") is the move when you toss for someone you are drawn to who has not joined yet, one of your sparks: `yourself` for a Wake Up or Clean Up cast, `them` (learning them, by curiosity and never pursuit) for Grow Up. A Show Up cast is the invitation, and its line is in connection.js.

readings.reading: You have been giving and giving, and nothing has had space to come back. Closeness needs a gap for the other side to fill.
readings.self: Do one act today that asks nothing of you, and let it be enough.
readings.them: Ask {name} one question today and wait for the whole answer before you say anything.

drawn.yourself: Notice how much you give in your head to {name}, and keep one hour today for yourself.
drawn.them: Next time you are with {name}, ask one question and let the silence after it be theirs.

readings.reading: You are carrying the whole weight of this, and nobody asked you to. Receiving is also a way of coming closer.
readings.self: Set down one weight today that you have been holding for someone else.
readings.them: Let {name} carry one small load for you this week, and thank them for it.

drawn.yourself: Name what you hope {name} will carry for you, and carry it yourself for a day.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} looks after, and ask them about it when it comes up.

readings.reading: This is early, and you are reading the mess as a verdict. New growth looks untidy before it takes root.
readings.self: Write one sentence about what is growing in you, and leave out how it should look.
readings.them: Tell {name} you are glad it is still early between you.

drawn.yourself: Write down what is new in you since {name} caught your eye, untidy as it is.
drawn.them: Learn one small, early fact about {name} and let it stay small.

readings.reading: You are guessing at what is felt where you could simply ask. Not knowing is a good place to start from.
readings.self: Ask yourself one plain question today and answer it out loud.
readings.them: Ask {name} about one feeling you have been guessing at.

drawn.yourself: Ask yourself what you are drawn to in {name}, and answer without dressing it up.
drawn.them: Next time {name} says something you do not follow, ask what they meant.

readings.reading: You are ready and the ground is not. Waiting well is a kind of care.
readings.self: Make yourself a cup of something warm and wait with it, without fixing anything.
readings.them: Make your Between ready for {name}: set something down there and let them find it.

drawn.yourself: Warm the corner of your own nook where you would sit with {name}, for yourself first.
drawn.them: Pay attention to what {name} is waiting on in their own life, and let it be theirs.

readings.reading: You are leaning in and holding back at once, and the two cancel. Choose one of them for today.
readings.self: Let your leaning in and your holding back each say one line.
readings.them: Tell {name} which way you lean today, closer or a step back, and why.

drawn.yourself: Let your leaning toward {name} and your holding back each say one line.
drawn.them: Notice whether {name} leans in or holds back with others, and stay curious about why.

readings.reading: Something would settle this, and you have not said it. A plain fact can gather what feelings scatter.
readings.self: Write down the one fact about this you keep stepping around.
readings.them: Tell {name} the one fact you have not said yet.

drawn.yourself: Say the plain fact of your pull toward {name} to yourself, out loud, once.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} does when plans scatter, and ask how they find their feet.

readings.reading: This bond is filling a hole you had before it began. That is not wrong, and it is worth knowing.
readings.self: Name the old hole gently, and give it one kindness of its own today.
readings.them: Thank {name} for one gift they give you without knowing they give it.

drawn.yourself: Name what was missing in you before {name} came into view.
drawn.them: Ask {name} who their people are, and listen for who they lean on.

readings.reading: A small habit you never revisited is holding all of this. Small habits, tended, change the weather.
readings.self: Find one small rule you keep with yourself and loosen it for a day.
readings.them: Ask {name} about one small habit between you, and whether it still fits.

drawn.yourself: Notice one small habit you have kept since you met {name}, and choose it on purpose.
drawn.them: Notice one small habit of {name}'s that you like, and ask where it comes from.

readings.reading: You are stepping onto ground that matters, and play is what makes it safe.
readings.self: Play at something today that has no point at all.
readings.them: Bring one game or one joke into your Between with {name}.

drawn.yourself: Find one playful act you would do even if {name} never saw it, and do it.
drawn.them: Notice what makes {name} laugh, and let that be what you learn next.

readings.reading: This is going well, and you should know why. Naming what is good helps it last.
readings.self: Write down one part of you that has been going right, and why.
readings.them: Tell {name} what is good between you, and what you think makes it so.

drawn.yourself: Write down why it feels good to think of {name}.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what has been going well for them lately.

readings.reading: You want one kind of closeness and you are showing the face of another. The gap shows.
readings.self: Notice which face you wear around others today, and take it off once.
readings.them: Tell {name} what you actually want from your time together.

drawn.yourself: Notice the face you show near {name}, and let it be closer to the one you feel.
drawn.them: Watch for the gap between what {name} shows and what they might feel, and stay kind about it.

readings.reading: You are walking the same way and neither of you has said so. Saying it makes it shared.
readings.self: Name the direction you are walking in, in one sentence.
readings.them: Tell {name} where you think the two of you are heading, and ask if they see it too.

drawn.yourself: Name where you are headed in your own life, with or without {name}.
drawn.them: Ask {name} where they are headed, and listen for where your ways meet.

readings.reading: There is plenty here, and all of it is in plain sight. Plenty asks to be shared, not guarded.
readings.self: Spend one hour today on something you love, in plain sight.
readings.them: Share one good moment with {name} today, out of fullness.

drawn.yourself: Write down three good gifts in your life that do not depend on {name}.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} gives freely, and tell them you noticed.

readings.reading: You are playing down what you feel. Modesty only helps while the feeling is still there underneath.
readings.self: Say out loud, alone, how much this matters to you.
readings.them: Let {name} see a little more of how much this matters to you.

drawn.yourself: Let yourself feel the full size of your pull toward {name}, alone, for one minute.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} plays down about themselves, and ask about it gently.

readings.reading: The best of it has already started, before anything happens. Looking forward together is closeness too.
readings.self: Plan one small treat to look forward to this week.
readings.them: Plan one outing with {name} that you can both look forward to.

drawn.yourself: Enjoy looking forward to seeing {name}, without needing it to go any way.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what they are looking forward to.

readings.reading: You opened something, and now you are inside what it opened. Let it lead for a while.
readings.self: Follow one impulse today that you would usually talk yourself out of.
readings.them: Let {name} choose what the two of you do next time.

drawn.yourself: Notice where your pull toward {name} is leading you, and follow it only as far as your own hearth.
drawn.them: Let {name} lead the next talk, and see where they take it.

readings.reading: This went stale from being left alone. Tending clears the air.
readings.self: Go back to one habit you dropped for yourself and give it five minutes.
readings.them: Tend your Between with {name} today: open it, look around, and set one corner right.

drawn.yourself: Air out one old story you carry about people like {name}.
drawn.them: Ask {name} about a love of theirs that has gone dormant, and listen without fixing it.

readings.reading: This is rising, and the season will not last forever. Warmth wants a reply while it is warm.
readings.self: Act on one good feeling today before it cools.
readings.them: Reach out to {name} today while the warmth is fresh.

drawn.yourself: Let yourself be warm today, and notice who besides {name} feels it.
drawn.them: Reply to the next warm word {name} says while it is still warm.

readings.reading: The place you watch from is itself in view. You are seen while you are seeing.
readings.self: Look at yourself today the way a kind friend would, for one full minute.
readings.them: Tell {name} one kindness you have watched them do well.

drawn.yourself: Notice how you watch {name}, and how it would feel to be watched that way.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what they notice about the place you both spend time in.

readings.reading: Something is lodged between you, and nothing closes until it is said.
readings.self: Write the words you have not said, and read them back to yourself.
readings.them: Tell {name} what has been in the way, kindly and plainly.

drawn.yourself: Name what in you keeps getting stuck when you think of {name}.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} chews on, and ask about it when the moment is right.

readings.reading: You have dressed this up, and the dressing is doing real good. Care in the small details is care.
readings.self: Make one small corner of your space beautiful for no one but you.
readings.them: Set something beautiful in your Between for {name} to find.

drawn.yourself: Take care of one small detail about yourself that has nothing to do with {name}.
drawn.them: Notice one small detail {name} takes care with, and tell them you saw it.

readings.reading: The ground under this is wearing away, and you have not said so. Saying it is how the slide stops.
readings.self: Notice one place you are running low, and give it rest today.
readings.them: Tell {name} gently that something between you feels thinner lately, and ask how it feels to them.

drawn.yourself: Name what you are afraid you would lose if you opened up to {name}.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} seems careful not to lose, and respect it.

readings.reading: Something came back, and it is still shallow. Let it return slowly.
readings.self: Take up one small joy that is coming back to you, and keep it small.
readings.them: Send {name} one small sign that you are glad they are back.

drawn.yourself: Let your pull toward {name} come back slowly today, without feeding it.
drawn.them: Ask {name} one light question about something they came back to.

readings.reading: Your next move has no calculation in it, and that is the exposure. It is also the gift.
readings.self: Say one true sentence to yourself without softening it.
readings.them: Tell {name} one honest sentence without planning how it lands.

drawn.yourself: Do one kind act near {name} today with no plan behind it.
drawn.them: Ask {name} one question you truly do not know the answer to.

readings.reading: You have been saving something up and never named the day. Care that is stored too long goes stale.
readings.self: Spend something you have been saving on yourself today.
readings.them: Name a day to give {name} what you have been saving for them.

drawn.yourself: Name what you have been saving up to say to {name}, and say it to yourself first.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what they are saving up for.

readings.reading: What this gives you is feeding you, uncounted. Notice what you take in.
readings.self: Eat one meal today slowly, and notice what nourishes you.
readings.them: Share tea with {name}, in person or in your Between.

drawn.yourself: Notice what you take in when you think of {name}, and feed yourself something good besides.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what feeds them on a hard day.

readings.reading: This is carrying more than what holds it up. Something needs to be set down before it bends.
readings.self: Take one load off your plate today, and do not make it up later.
readings.them: Ask {name} what feels heavy between you, and offer to set one load down together.

drawn.yourself: Set down one hope about {name} that is more than this can carry yet.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} is carrying, and ask if they want to talk about it.

readings.reading: There is a deeper layer under the deep one. Going down together needs a hand to hold.
readings.self: Sit with the feeling under the feeling for three breaths.
readings.them: Ask {name} one question that goes one layer deeper than usual.

drawn.yourself: Go one layer down: what does your pull toward {name} want for you?
drawn.them: Ask {name} about something that matters to them, and stay with the answer.

readings.reading: You keep saying the same true sentence, and it is burning up what it is about. A flame needs something to rest on.
readings.self: Stop telling one story about yourself for a day.
readings.them: Say what you keep saying to {name} once more in new words, then let it rest.

drawn.yourself: Say once what is true for you about {name}, and then rest from saying it.
drawn.them: Notice what lights {name} up, and ask what keeps that going.

readings.reading: The movement came because you stopped pushing. Influence runs both ways when one of you waits.
readings.self: Stop trying for one hour and see what comes to you.
readings.them: Wait for {name} to reach first this time, and answer warmly when they do.

drawn.yourself: Stop leaning toward {name} for a day, and notice what moves in you.
drawn.them: Wait for {name} to bring something up, and follow their lead.

readings.reading: This exchange has happened before. A pattern that lasts can be kept on purpose.
readings.self: Name one rhythm in your days you want to keep, and keep it today.
readings.them: Choose one ritual with {name} and do it again this week.

drawn.yourself: Notice how your pull toward {name} echoes pulls you have felt before, and keep what you like in it.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} keeps doing week after week, and ask what it means to them.

readings.reading: Stepping back is open to you, and the timing decides what you keep. A kind retreat is still contact.
readings.self: Take one hour alone today, and call it rest rather than escape.
readings.them: Tell {name} you need a little space, and when you will be back.

drawn.yourself: Take one step back from thinking about {name}, kindly, and see what you keep.
drawn.them: Notice when {name} steps back, and give them space.

readings.reading: There is force here, and it has no aim yet. Strength needs gentleness to arrive as care.
readings.self: Put your energy into one movement your body enjoys.
readings.them: Do one strong, kind act for {name}, and ask first whether they want it.

drawn.yourself: Put the strength of your pull toward {name} into one gentle act for yourself.
drawn.them: Notice where {name} is strong, and ask how they grew it.

readings.reading: This is coming into view faster than you planned. Let it be seen.
readings.self: Let one person see something you usually keep to yourself.
readings.them: Let {name} see how much you enjoy them.

drawn.yourself: Let yourself be seen a little more today, by {name} or by anyone.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} lets people see, and ask about one piece of it.

readings.reading: You are keeping a light covered, and it is still lit. Some warmth is kept safe by staying hidden for a while.
readings.self: Keep one tender feeling to yourself today, and tend it in private.
readings.them: Leave a small light in your Between for {name}, without a word.

drawn.yourself: Keep the light you carry for {name} covered today, and notice that it stays lit.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} keeps private, and leave it covered.

readings.reading: An arrangement has formed between you without being talked about. Naming it lets you both choose it.
readings.self: Name one arrangement you live by, and decide whether you still choose it.
readings.them: Ask {name} about one unspoken arrangement between you.

drawn.yourself: Name the small ritual that has grown in you since {name}, and choose it.
drawn.them: Ask {name} how their days usually go.

readings.reading: You reached a conclusion from far away. Closeness starts by closing the distance.
readings.self: Check one conclusion you have reached about yourself, close up.
readings.them: Ask {name} what they meant before you decide it for them.

drawn.yourself: Notice one verdict you reached about {name} from far away, and set it down.
drawn.them: Close a little distance: ask {name} about one guess you have only kept in your head.

readings.reading: The direct way is closed, and you have not asked for help. Asking is the way around.
readings.self: Ask one friend for help with something small today.
readings.them: Ask {name} to help you find the way around what is stuck between you.

drawn.yourself: Ask a friend what they see in you, before you look to {name} for it.
drawn.them: Ask {name} for help with one small question they know about.

readings.reading: The knot just loosened, and the opening is short. Ease is a time to move gently.
readings.self: Make the gentle move you have been putting off, today, while it is easy.
readings.them: Reach out to {name} today, while it is easy between you.

drawn.yourself: Loosen one knot in you about {name}, gently, today.
drawn.them: Notice when {name} is at ease, and ask what helped.

readings.reading: This has a price, and you have not named it. Naming what you give keeps it a gift.
readings.self: Write what you are giving up for this, and whether you still choose it.
readings.them: Tell {name} plainly what you have been giving, without asking for anything back.

drawn.yourself: Name what thinking of {name} costs you, and what it gives.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what they give their time to.

readings.reading: More is arriving than you put in. Let the extra flow outward.
readings.self: Pass one gift you received today on to someone else.
readings.them: Give {name} something extra, with nothing tied to it.

drawn.yourself: Let some of the warmth you feel for {name} go to someone else today.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} is glad to share, and receive it.

readings.reading: One sentence is still unsaid, and it is leaking out anyway. Saying it cleanly is kinder.
readings.self: Say the unsaid sentence to yourself, out loud.
readings.them: Say the one unsaid sentence to {name}, simply.

drawn.yourself: Write the one sentence you have not said to {name}, and keep it for yourself for now.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} seems to almost say, and leave space for it.

readings.reading: You are building a lot on one moment. One moment is a beginning, not a proof.
readings.self: Notice one story you built on one moment, and hold it lightly.
readings.them: Ask {name} for one more moment before you decide what the first one meant.

drawn.yourself: Notice how much you are building on one moment with {name}, and let it be a beginning.
drawn.them: Learn one more ordinary fact about {name} before you decide anything.

readings.reading: You came together, and you may have forgotten why. Remembering the reason renews it.
readings.self: Write down why you began what you are in, and read it slowly.
readings.them: Remind {name} why you first wanted to be close.

drawn.yourself: Remember why {name} caught your eye in the first place, and write it down.
drawn.them: Ask {name} how they came to be where they are.

readings.reading: This is growing at a pace you cannot see day to day. Trust the slope.
readings.self: Look back a month and name one way you have grown.
readings.them: Tell {name} one way you have grown closer since you began.

drawn.yourself: Trust that your own growth is happening, with or without {name} in view.
drawn.them: Notice one way {name} has grown since you first saw them.

readings.reading: The explaining goes on and the basin is dry. Rest before you say more.
readings.self: Stop explaining yourself for a day, even in your own head.
readings.them: Tell {name} you are tired of explaining, and ask to just sit together.

drawn.yourself: Rest from explaining your pull toward {name}, even to yourself.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what tires them out, and listen without advice.

readings.reading: What you want is right there, and your way of reaching it is broken. Mend the rope, and the water is still there.
readings.self: Mend one small break that keeps you from what you need.
readings.them: Ask {name} how they would like you to reach them.

drawn.yourself: Mend one way you reach for closeness that keeps breaking, before you reach toward {name}.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} draws on when they need it, and ask about it.

readings.reading: You are shedding an old skin, and the new one is soft. Let yourself be seen tender.
readings.self: Treat yourself today the way you would treat someone who is healing.
readings.them: Tell {name} you are changing, and that it makes you a little tender.

drawn.yourself: Let yourself be tender about {name}, alone, for one minute.
drawn.them: Notice something {name} is outgrowing, and be kind about it.

readings.reading: Something is changing between you, and you are carrying it by the handles. Hold it steady while it cooks.
readings.self: Give one change in you a day to settle before you judge it.
readings.them: Make something with {name}, together, in your Between.

drawn.yourself: Hold your pull toward {name} steady today, without stirring it.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what is changing for them.

readings.reading: It went off, and it may go off again. After a shock, steadiness is the gift.
readings.self: After a jolt today, take three slow breaths before you answer anything.
readings.them: Check on {name} after the last jolt between you, and ask how they are now.

drawn.yourself: After the jolt of seeing {name}, steady your breath and your feet.
drawn.them: Notice how {name} steadies after a surprise.

readings.reading: The move is to stop while the wanting is still running. Stillness can be shared.
readings.self: Sit still for five minutes and let the wanting run without following it.
readings.them: Sit with {name} in your Between without needing anything to happen.

drawn.yourself: Stop while the wanting for {name} is still running, and sit with it.
drawn.them: Sit in stillness near {name} once, and notice what they are like when nothing is asked of them.

readings.reading: This has stages, and you are trying to skip one. Closeness comes at its own pace.
readings.self: Name the stage you are in, and let it be enough for now.
readings.them: Ask {name} what the next small step between you might be.

drawn.yourself: Name the stage you are at with {name}, and stay in it for now.
drawn.them: Learn about {name} the way you would in an early stage of knowing someone.

readings.reading: You are following rules nobody told you. Ask how life goes in their world.
readings.self: Notice one rule you follow that no one ever said out loud.
readings.them: Ask {name} how life goes in their world, and listen.

drawn.yourself: Notice the rules you are following around {name} that nobody gave you.
drawn.them: Ask {name} how life goes in their world.

readings.reading: This is at its peak, and you are holding some of it back. Enjoy it fully while it is full.
readings.self: Let yourself enjoy one pleasure completely today.
readings.them: Show {name} all of your gladness this time, not just part of it.

drawn.yourself: Enjoy how full you feel when {name} comes to mind, and let it be enough today.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} enjoys most, and enjoy it with them.

readings.reading: You feel like a stranger here, and first impressions come fast. Be a gracious guest.
readings.self: Be gentle with yourself somewhere new today.
readings.them: Ask {name} to show you something of theirs, and be a good guest.

drawn.yourself: Be a gracious guest in your own feelings about {name}.
drawn.them: Be curious about the places {name} calls home, and ask about one.

readings.reading: You are already having an effect, and you have not owned it. Gentle influence is safe once it is owned.
readings.self: Notice one way you shape your own mood, and use it kindly.
readings.them: Ask {name} how you affect them lately, and listen.

drawn.yourself: Own the effect {name} has on you, and the effect you might have.
drawn.them: Notice the small ways {name} affects people around them, and ask what they care about.

readings.reading: The exchange is already the whole of it. Joy shared is the point.
readings.self: Let yourself laugh today, on purpose.
readings.them: Trade one joke or one light moment with {name} today.

drawn.yourself: Enjoy the next exchange with {name} for what it is.
drawn.them: Ask {name} what made them laugh this week.

readings.reading: What you held rigid is coming apart. Let it soften instead of holding it together.
readings.self: Let go of one rigid plan for yourself today.
readings.them: Let one old stance with {name} soften, and tell them so.

drawn.yourself: Let one rigid idea of how this should go with {name} soften.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} holds loosely, and ask about it.

readings.reading: You are past what you can hold, and you have not said where your edge is. Limits make closeness safe.
readings.self: Name one limit for yourself today and keep it.
readings.them: Tell {name} where your edge is, kindly and clearly.

drawn.yourself: Name your own edge: how much of yourself you want to spend thinking of {name}.
drawn.them: Notice the limits {name} keeps, and respect them.

readings.reading: What is true here is still inside the shell. Warmth helps it hatch.
readings.self: Keep one new feeling warm and private for a while longer.
readings.them: Give {name} warmth today without asking for what is not ready yet.

drawn.yourself: Keep what is true for you about {name} warm, and let it hatch in its own time.
drawn.them: Ask {name} about something they care about without saying so.

readings.reading: You are doing slightly too much. Small and steady comes closer than grand.
readings.self: Do one kindness for yourself today at half the size you planned.
readings.them: Do one small kindness for {name} instead of a big one.

drawn.yourself: Do one small kindness for yourself today instead of a grand plan with {name} in your head.
drawn.them: Ask {name} one small question, and let it stay small.

readings.reading: Something is complete, and that is when it starts to move again. Tend what you have, so it stays.
readings.self: Take care of one gift you already have, today.
readings.them: Tend your Between with {name}: keep up what is already good there.

drawn.yourself: Tend what you already have in your life, so it stays, whatever happens with {name}.
drawn.them: Notice what {name} has settled into, and ask how it came together.

readings.reading: You are nearly there, and the last stride is where you get wet. Go carefully at the end.
readings.self: Finish one small promise to yourself, carefully.
readings.them: Take the last small step toward {name} you have been hovering before.

drawn.yourself: Go carefully with yourself at the edge of this, before any word to {name}.
drawn.them: Learn one more fact about {name} before you take the last step.
